definitions.gloss: plain-grilled fish (especially eel); grilling without sauce
definitions.explanation: Fish, usually eel, grilled without sauce or seasoning, and eaten with wasabi and soy sauce or salt.

examples.japanese: うなぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白焼|しらや}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
{白焼|しらや}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わさび{醤油|じょうゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Shirayaki is eaten with wasabi and soy sauce.

examples.japanese: {白焼|しらや}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、うなぎ⟦{本来|ほんらい}→本来：09644_honrai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わかる。
examples.english: Because shirayaki is made without sauce, you can really taste the eel itself.

notes:
USAGE:
{白|しら} (plain, unadorned) + ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grilling). Also the first, unsauced grilling of eel before the sauce is brushed on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うなぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白焼|しらや}き: plain-grilled eel
- あなご⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白焼|しらや}き: plain-grilled conger eel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蒲焼|かばや}き→蒲焼き：29221_kabayaki⟧: eel grilled with a sweet soy-based sauce, the usual way
